CustomField.description: CSS width value applied to inline-mode field labels (e.g. 20rem, 400px, calc(33% - 1rem)). Only used when Label Variant is set to label-inline. Sets the --flowtoolkit-inline-label-width CSS custom property on the field at render time.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: CSS width for the inline label column (e.g. 20rem, 400px). Only applies when Label Variant is set to label-inline.
CustomField.label: Inline Label Width
